Helena (docs): Quick heads-up  migration PR #1420 landed but CI flagged a few broken snippets and one bad anchor. Can someone take a look so we don't ship stale examples?
Marco (eng-sdk): Saw the failures. The JS examples in the guide still show `tool.call(name, args)`; our SDK now uses `client.execute({ action: { name, args } })`. Easy fix but we should standardize the sample response shape too.
Pri (devex): I can patch JS + Python. Can we confirm canonical response shape and the JSON schema to display? The snippets in the SDK tests expect `data` -> `id`, but docs currently show `result`.
Jun (eng-ml): Canonical we've been converging on: `{ status: 'ok' | 'error', data?: object, error?: { code, message } }`. For success `data` is required; `error` only appears on failure. Recommend updating examples to `data`.
Helena (docs): OK switching to `data`. Also CI's link-checker flagged a broken anchor linking to `#response-contracts` in the migration guide. The heading was renamed to "Response contract and guardrails" so anchor should be `#response-contract-and-guardrails` per our generator.
linkbot: link-check(https://docs.redwood.ai/migrate#response-contracts) -> 404 (suggest: #response-contract-and-guardrails)
Marco (eng-sdk): Two other small things: 1) add a guardrail note: "Treat `error` as the canonical failure indicator; do not infer failure from missing `data` fields." 2) update the unit test snippet in the docs to assert `res.data.id` so future drift breaks early.
Pri (devex): I'll add a side-by-side Python snippet and a short Go example for parity. Proposed JS snippet:
```js
const res = await client.execute({ action: { name: 'notebook.create', args: { title: 'Q3 notes' } } });
// res.status === 'ok'
// res.data -> { id: 'nb_001', owner: 'team-x' }
```
Helena (docs): Good. For schema block I'll mark `data` required when `status` == 'ok' and include the guardrail wording Marco suggested. Also add a micro-example showing `error` shape.
Jun (eng-ml): Tiny wording nit: prefer "do not treat missing `data` fields as implicit failures". Slightly clearer for readers.
Helena (docs): Nice, I'll use that phrasing.
linkbot: PR #1426  linkcheck -> anchor fix required.
Pri (devex): I've pushed JS/Python/Go snippets plus the schema change and guardrail text in a small PR #1426. Dropping link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1426
Marco (eng-sdk): Reviewing now. Adding a one-line Jest snippet to docs/tests/snippets.test.js that asserts `expect(res.data.id).toBeDefined()`.
Jun (eng-ml): Quick sanity: include a short note about not relying on `data.meta.created_at` for cross-shard ordering; prefer server-assigned sequence ids when ordering matters.
Helena (docs): Adding that as a second guardrail bullet. Pushed an update. CI requeued.
linkbot: PR #1426  ci/linkcheck  passed.
Marco (eng-sdk): LGTM, merged. :tada:
Helena (docs): Thanks everyone. I'll run a fast grep for other `tool.call`/`result` references and open follow-ups as needed. If you catch any other anchors or wording inconsistencies, drop them here and I'll batch them into an audit PR.
Pri (devex): Filing a docs-advisory ticket to keep SDK snippets synced across languages. :clipboard:
